versions.changelog:
Initial release of content-writer-delivery skill:

- Delivers reviewed articles to user-selected local files, document services, or publishing platforms after explicit user confirmation.
- Requires confirmation of target path, visibility, and publication type before any action.
- Supports copy-ready output in Markdown or HTML by default.
- Only acts on final articles and never selects destinations or publishes without user direction.
- Strictly limits actions to the specified article and target; avoids inspecting unrelated data or changing sharing settings.
